metaData.originalTitle: 下一代大模型推理网络架构：ZCube 如何有效破解网络瓶颈？
metaData.title: Next-Generation Large Model Inference Network Architecture: How ZCube Effectively Breaks the Network Bottleneck?
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Zhipu AI, XunYin Network, and Tsinghua University jointly proposed the ZCube networking architecture. By employing a flat topology and a hybrid single/multi-rail access method, it achieves a 33% cost reduction, over 15% throughput improvement, and a 40.6% reduction in TTFT P99 in a thousand-card inference cluster, effectively solving the structural network congestion problem in PD-separated inference.
metaData.summary: This article details the ZCube network architecture jointly proposed by Zhipu AI, XunYin Network, and Tsinghua University, aimed at solving the increasingly severe structural network congestion problem in large model PD-separated inference scenarios. The article first demonstrates through controlled experiments that network bandwidth is a key factor affecting inference throughput and latency. It then analyzes the load hotspots and PFC backpressure issues in the traditional RoFT architecture caused by the source-destination asymmetry of KV Cache transmission in PD-separated inference. The core innovation of the ZCube architecture lies in: eliminating the Spine layer switches, adopting a fully flat network topology, dividing Leaf switches into odd and even groups with a complete bipartite graph interconnection, and connecting the two ports of the GPU NIC to the two groups of switches via single-rail and multi-rail methods respectively. This design ensures only one optimal path between any pair of GPUs, fundamentally avoiding multi-path routing conflicts and achieving ideal load balancing across all switches in the network. In real-world tests on a thousand-card GLM-5.1 coding production cluster, compared to the RoFT architecture, ZCube saves 1/3 of the switch and optical module costs while increasing the average GPU inference throughput by over 15% and reducing the TTFT P99 by 40.6%. The architecture has been running stably for over two weeks, proving that architectural innovation is an effective path to unlocking hardware potential.

mainPoints.point: Network bandwidth has become one of the core factors limiting large model inference performance.
mainPoints.explanation: Controlled experiments show that increasing NIC bandwidth from 100Gbps to 200Gbps improves total inference throughput by approximately 19% and reduces TTFT by about 22%, proving that the network has evolved from a supporting infrastructure to a key variable determining system performance.

mainPoints.point: The traditional RoFT architecture faces severe structural congestion issues in PD-separated inference.
mainPoints.explanation: The source-destination asymmetry of KV Cache transmission causes the static rail mapping of RoFT to fail, leading to local hotspots, queue buildup, and PFC backpressure, creating a structural problem where total bandwidth is abundant but local congestion is frequent.

mainPoints.point: ZCube achieves global load balancing through a flat topology and hybrid single/multi-rail access.
mainPoints.explanation: By eliminating the Spine layer, using a complete bipartite graph interconnection of odd-even Leaf switches, and connecting the dual ports of GPUs via single-rail and multi-rail methods, ZCube ensures only one optimal path between any pair of GPUs, architecturally eliminating avoidable congestion.

mainPoints.point: ZCube achieves significant cost reduction and efficiency gains in real-world thousand-card cluster tests.
mainPoints.explanation: In the GLM-5.1 coding production environment, compared to the RoFT architecture, ZCube saves 33% on network hardware costs while increasing the average GPU inference throughput by over 15% and reducing the TTFT P99 by 40.6%.

keyQuotes: The network is no longer just a supporting infrastructure; it has evolved into a key variable determining the throughput, tail latency, and overall MaaS cost of large model inference systems.

ZCube's breakthrough strategy is to 'respond to dynamics with dynamics,' adopting a fully flat network topology combined with a hybrid single/multi-rail access mechanism to globally decouple and discretely route PD traffic at the structural level.
System-level innovation in architecture is the most economical and elegant path to unlocking hardware potential.

For GPU and server hardware of the same scale and configuration, without modifying any applications, upgrading the networking architecture to ZCube not only saved us 1/3 of the optical modules and switches but also allowed the cluster to serve over 15% more inference requests per second.

relatedArticles.title: GLM-5V-Turbo Released: A Multimodal Coding Foundation Model
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Zhipu AI has released GLM-5V-Turbo, a multimodal coding foundation model that supports native visual understanding and code generation, is deeply optimized for Agent scenarios, and offers a 200k context window.

relatedArticles.title: Scaling Pain: Large-Scale Coding Agent Inference Practices
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Zhipu AI shares the process of identifying, locating, and fixing three types of abnormal outputs (garbled text, repetition, and rare characters) caused by high concurrency and long contexts in large-scale Coding Agent inference scenarios, and proposes a KV Cache layered storage optimization solution.

relatedArticles.title: Kimi's New Paper: Turning KV Cache into a New Business Model
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Moonshot AI and Tsinghua University jointly propose the Prefill-as-a-Service architecture, which compresses the KV Cache through hybrid attention models, enabling its transmission across data centers via standard Ethernet, thereby achieving geo-distributed heterogeneous scheduling of Prefill and Decode, significantly improving long-context reasoning performance.

relatedArticles.title: GLM-5-Turbo: An OpenClaw-Enhanced Foundation Model
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Zhipu AI released the GLM-5-Turbo model, deeply optimized for Agent scenarios, significantly enhancing its tool calling and long-chain execution capabilities, and simultaneously introduced OpenClaw service packages and a security management system.

relatedArticles.title: GLM-5.1 High-Speed: 400 tokens/s, Top-Tier Model at Blazing Speed
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Zhipu AI releases the GLM-5.1 High-Speed API, achieving an output speed of 400 tokens/s, delivering extreme low latency while retaining flagship model capabilities, and introduces the underlying TileRT high-performance inference engine technology.

relatedArticles.title: Zhipu AI Reveals the Secret Behind "Degraded Intelligence": The Inevitable Pain of Scaling
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Zhipu AI publicly disclosed the garbled text, repetition, and other anomalies in the GLM-5 series models during the Scaling process, caused by defects in high-load inference state management, and shared practical experience in locating, fixing, and optimizing these issues.

relatedArticles.title: GLM-5.1 Open Source: A Model Capable of 8 Hours of Independent Work
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Zhipu AI releases its flagship model GLM-5.1, featuring breakthrough Long-Horizon Task capabilities that allow it to work independently for 8 hours and deliver engineering-grade results.
